breaking.change: Removed -og-emitter without an alias. Particle emission is a reflected og-emitter element behavior, not a style declaration.
breaking.fix: Move the former value to <og-emitter effect="confetti 70 burst 110 for 1.4s">. Keep position, dimensions and visibility in standard CSS. The effect attribute supports expressions; keyed insertion starts a new emitter. Presets, rates, one-shot bursts, timing, seeded replay and reduced-motion suppression are unchanged.
